resources.string: Send text, credentials, and data between phones using ultrasonic and audible acoustic synthesis. Zero Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, or cloud connection required.
Encode your message into Goertzel MFSK16 sound tones.
Nearby receiving device captures audio via its microphone.
Reed-Solomon GF(256) error correction verifies payload integrity.
Volume: Set media speaker volume between 70% and 90% for optimal acoustic SNR.
Range: Near-ultrasound Stealth mode works reliably up to 0.5 meters.
Privacy: Sound waves are acoustic—use Secure Mode with a passphrase for confidential data.
Pets: Near-ultrasound can be audible to domestic pets; keep sound levels considerate.
ShoutSend analyzes acoustic frequencies locally in real-time. Audio is processed strictly in volatile memory, never recorded to storage, and never transmitted over the internet.
To receive acoustic transmissions and calibrate frequency response, ShoutSend requires microphone access to detect audio carrier frequencies.
Microphone permission has been permanently denied. Please enable microphone access in Android application settings to receive sonic data.
